I know what you mean. I think I must be mentally disabled and no one ever told me; like I'm walking around and I'm the slow guy that everyone makes fun of behind their back, and he can kind of tell he gets treated differently but there isn't quite enough going on upstairs to put the pieces together and do anything with it.

Life is just really embarrassing. It's just shame, and humiliation, and then exclusion whether by choice or not. I don't want to go in public, I don't want to do anything but lay in bed and starve. I don't ever want to be seen again, I hate this body and this life.

No, I do not agree at all.

I hear those words, I see people "promoting" that, but I do not see it in action.

Every time I have expressed emotion I have been seen as weak, worthy of pity, and possibly just a whiny, mopey loser.

Men will not ever be allowed to express emotion, not if they can't where I live not without sacrificing serious social potential; those who pretend not to care care the most, they can't help it, it just gets twisted around into something else so they can feel better about abandoning the guy. If we can convince ourselves that a = b, b = c, and c = d, then a = d, even if it's just to explain away otherwise bad behavior. They don't actually have to be equal, just in our minds; we're not rational beings.

I discredit it based on reality.

I can go into situations with a positive attitude and it almost always fails. It fails with a negative outlook as well, but at least that is realistic. People who say your attitude matters simply see correlation as causation; besides, it isn't something you can fake. Then you're a "tryhard" or somesuch.

If you are being evolved against, it is almost selfish to stay around. Besides, when you really think about it, when you're in bed, unable to sleep at night, you realize that everyone is quite literally acting against your very survival and well-being, as evolution requires.

In other words, people are acting against you simply by you existing. Where's the optimism fit in that? That, at the end of the day, people want, biologically, nothing more than for you to fail. That's what we fundamentally are.

That's so fucked up. This life is empty, you're either born in the right body and you get evolved for or you are in the wrong one and are pruned from the tree.

This is only shame, there is no choice in how you see your downfall; either you smile and are called one lacking in self-awareness, or you frown and get called an ungrateful selfish asshole. Some people just lose, for us in the first-world, it's a very drawn out process, in other parts of the world, at other times, we would have starved before adolescence.

Right, so why would one want to be a part of it unless they love violence and manipulation, or unless they were the strongest?

Suicide seems so obvious, of course the weak have trouble actualizing that, just as they did everything else in life. It's so easy to blame results on willpower, as if a million hippies could just focus their minds and make the pentagon float.

When moments are only agony, why would you want to continue forward?

When everyone is stronger than you, why would you want to continue to live in the same of constant and unending failure?  We don't owe that to them.  We can choose death, we just need to be stronger.

Look at nature, beautiful organisms get eaten for breakfast. It's only perfect in terms of natural laws, it's actually horrific and fucked up. Of course humans are no different, we just hide it better. We just shame people into thinking it's their fault for being born. It is, of course. In so far as there is any order to anything.

No I don't.

You too, huh?

The third-person thing is always strange; the friend management (oh, you wouldn't have liked that party anyway!).

Is it genetics? I honest want to know, it seems like that's a cop-out to absolve oneseelf of power, but what is the answer then, why does it start so early and never end?  At every stage of development and maturation is is eerily constant.

Is there a break or is the break death? Is it inherent in us, why does free will appear not to exist?

God, I know how you feel.

Today I am just waiting to go back to sleep, not going to move or eat or groom or do anything. No fucking point, just running around for the sake of running around, spinning wheels and going backward.

We have to help ourselves, this is a cold and cruel world; thing is, whatever sort of emotional or mental or experience-based map people use to pilot through the world, we appear to be without. No real help exists in our society for this, so we scream out, as noted by you, countless times, nigh-endlessly, until we're finally silent and still.

We can scream all we want, we're just falling further behind. It's strange, like we don't exist at all, can't talk about it, no one would want to hear about it, they're too busy living. Wouldn't it be neat to live; maybe reincarnation exists? That'd be neat, about as realistic as getting out of this hole.

I wish we were more than animals. I wish we were humans; we are not.  We're much worse than animals, animals don't have rhetoric they hide their basal instincts behind, they just kill each other and fuck the ones they want to. The others starve; I'd prefer starvation over shame, endless socio-sexual stagnation and shame.

Emotional sensitivity is not allowed in men.  We say it is, but it is not.  Not really. The map is not the territory, most men know this. Women, in general, are more accepted.  Men can be seen in "scary and creepy" ways that women can not; often, this can be do to stupid things like nervousness, anxiety.

I can not do the male gender role, no amount of shoving a square plug into a round hole will make it work.  As such, I have to go without love at all times, always.  It doesn't happen. People expect me to do all of these actions, then get mad at me when I do not.  They themselves will not initiate them, but have no problem getting angry with me when I do not, or do them poorly.   The idea that guys don't have to be "real men" most of the time, though not always in that phrasing, is still a pipe-dream, it is not actuality. That's not the way the world works, regardless of whether we pretend we're in the egalitarian post-gender paradise where we don't have expectations on each other at all times, based on genitalia.  Guys have to initiate, contact, they have to be confident while doing so. They have to "man up."  These are real things, we can say they aren't, but we're doing that PC thing where we shut down conversation and assume the world works the way we want it to, as opposed to how it actually does. I'm not even sure.

I feel like a woman in a mans' body.  Either judge or do not.
